SkyfireAI and DBOX plan an integrated autonomous drone system

An MOU supported by Drone Nerds and XTI Aerospace targets US integration, with a demonstration planned for the fourth quarter of 2026.

DRONELIFE ↗25 September 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A framework for joint development

DRONELIFE reports that SkyfireAI and DBOX signed an MOU at the Lithuania–US Business Forum in Miami. XTI Aerospace and its Drone Nerds subsidiary helped establish the collaboration, aiming to integrate an autonomous drone operating system for the US market.

Complementary components

SkyfireAI contributes mission control, autonomy and multi-aircraft orchestration. DBOX, developed by Lithuania’s IT Logika, supplies autonomous docking infrastructure. XTI Aerospace and Drone Nerds support program leadership, integration and commercialization.

Testing comes before deployment

Initial work covers integration, testing, safety systems, relevant approvals and operator training. The companies plan a combined demonstration in the fourth quarter of 2026, targeting applications such as public safety and critical infrastructure.

An MOU is not a completed installation

The agreement supports further technical and commercial work. It does not establish that commercial deployment or beyond-visual-line-of-sight permissions are complete everywhere. The planned tests and demonstration will provide the next evidence of progress.
